scope: Manual review of locked installation paths whose installed directory has no top-level LICENSE/COPYING/NOTICE file. Published npm tarballs were downloaded and listed; none of the reviewed versions ships such a file. Statuses describe located evidence, not legal approval.

statuses.text-located: Full license text exists in the installed package or in upstream source at, or predating, the published version.
statuses.notice-only: A copyright or license statement exists, but no full license text was located.
statuses.declaration-only: Only the manifest license declaration was located; upstream source at the published version has no license text.
